# Course support

<br>

Most of you will need help at some point and we want to make sure you can identify when that is without getting too frustrated and feel comfortable seeking help.

## Lectures/Tutorials

If you have a question during lecture/tutorials, feel free to ask it! There are likely other students with the same question, so by asking you will create a learning opportunity for everyone.

## Email

Please feel free to raise any course content questions in class, as this helps the entire group learn and improve together. If there is a question that's not appropriate for the public forum, you are welcome to email me directly. **If you email me, please include "MS6071" in the subject line.** Barring extenuating circumstances, I will respond to MS6071 emails within 48 hours Monday - Friday. Response time may be slower for emails sent Friday evening - Sunday.
